name: meross
title: Meross
description: Control your Meross smart plugs and power strips from Raycast
author: joinsider

commands.name: devices
commands.title: Search Devices
commands.subtitle: Meross
commands.description: List your Meross plugs and switch them on or off

commands.name: toggle-device
commands.title: Toggle Device
commands.subtitle: Meross
commands.description: Pick an online plug and toggle it

commands.name: switch-device
commands.title: Switch Device by Name
commands.subtitle: Meross
commands.description: Switch a plug by its exact name, without opening a window (for hotkeys and quicklinks)

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Menu Bar Devices
commands.subtitle: Meross
commands.description: Show your Meross plugs in the menu bar

commands.name: logout
commands.title: Log out
commands.subtitle: Meross
commands.description: End the Meross cloud session and forget the stored login token

preferences.name: email
preferences.title: Email
preferences.description: Email address of your Meross account

preferences.name: localHttpFirst
preferences.title: Local Network
preferences.label: Control devices over the local network first
preferences.description: Send commands directly to the device via HTTP when its LAN IP is known, and fall back to the cloud otherwise
